The blur mask fluctuates through a 2-second cycle.
This is a visual blur, without a fixed world-distance cutoff.

entries.name: Far Sighted{[lvl]} (1 skull)
details: Blur strength: 1.00x the 1-skull setting.
The blur mask fluctuates through a 12-second cycle.
This is a visual blur, without a fixed world-distance cutoff.

entries.name: Far Sighted{[lvl]} (2 skulls)

The blur mask fluctuates through a 12-second cycle.

entries.name: Far Sighted{[lvl]} (3 skulls)

entries.name: Migraine{[lvl]} (1 skull)
details: Glare strength: 1x the 1-skull setting.
Brightness fluctuates through an 8-second curve.
The strength is a visual-effect scale, not a damage or sight-distance penalty.

entries.name: Migraine{[lvl]} (2 skulls)
details: Glare strength: 2x the 1-skull setting.
Brightness fluctuates through an 8-second curve.
The strength is a visual-effect scale, not a damage or sight-distance penalty.

entries.name: Concussion{[lvl]} (1 skull)
details: The blackout blend animates through a 2-second cycle while active.
This animation period is not a guaranteed duration of total blindness.

entries.name: Concussion{[lvl]} (2 skulls)
details: The blackout blend animates through a 2-second cycle while active.
This animation period is not a guaranteed duration of total blindness.

entries.name: Hemophobia{[lvl]} (1 skull)
details: Nearby-corpse influence fades with distance, reaching zero at about 3 world units.
The obscuring effect builds while near a corpse and recovers when you move away.

entries.name: Hemophobia{[lvl]} (2 skulls)
details: Nearby-corpse influence fades with distance, reaching zero at about 3 world units.
The obscuring effect builds while near a corpse and recovers when you move away.

entries.name: Chain Breaker
details: Cutting checks for the nearest chain segment within 1 world unit of the attack point.
There is no random success roll in this check.
A successful cut consumes the tool.

entries.name: Obsidian Pilum
details: Spear projectile base impact damage: 25.
Held-weapon base melee damage: 7.
These are prefab base values; charge, variation and other damage modifiers still apply.

entries.name: Obsidian Hammer
details: Held-weapon base damage: 7.
Toss landing base damage: 2.
Thrown-weapon base damage: 7, with 2.5 seconds of trip and 4 units of knockback.
Final damage and actual travel can change with combat modifiers or obstacles.

entries.name: Bow And Quiver
details: Quiver capacity: 8 shots before durability modifiers.
Ordinary fired arrow base damage: 12.
Throwing the bow itself uses a different projectile with 5 base damage.
Final damage changes with charge, variation and other modifiers.

entries.name: Poison Bow
details: Poison-arrow base impact damage: 10.
Weak duration from the arrow: 15 seconds.
Weak: -25% damage, movement speed and normal stamina recovery.
Final damage can change with charge and other modifiers.
Weak itself does not reduce maximum stamina.

entries.name: Explosive Bow
details: Explosive-arrow base impact damage: 5.
Explosion base damage: 9; radius: 4 world units.
These are separate damage sources, not a guaranteed 14 HP per hit.
Combat modifiers, positioning and defenses affect the result.

entries.name: Wooden Club
details: Club base melee damage: 10.
Thrown club base impact damage: 15.
Shield smashing is a separate weapon flag; durability is 2 before modifiers.
Final damage can change with charge and other modifiers.

entries.name: Unsteady{[lvl]} (1 skull)
details: Chain trips stun you for 1 base second.
Other stun/trip modifiers still apply.

entries.name: Unsteady{[lvl]} (2 skulls)
details: Chain trips trip you for 2 base seconds.
Other stun/trip modifiers still apply.

entries.name: Paranoia{[lvl]} (1 skull)
details: Active enemy-hallucination cap: 2 per affected player.
Further hallucinations are suppressed while that cap is reached.

entries.name: Paranoia{[lvl]} (2 skulls)
details: Active enemy-hallucination cap: 2 per affected player.
Further hallucinations are suppressed while that cap is reached.

entries.name: Paranoia{[lvl]} (3 skulls)
details: Active enemy-hallucination cap: 3 per affected player.
Further hallucinations are suppressed while that cap is reached.

entries.name: Psychosis{[lvl]} (1 skull)
details: A pickup-hallucination spawn is checked after more than 20 seconds.
Active pickup-hallucination cap: 12 per affected player.
Spawns need an available location and stop while the cap is reached.

entries.name: Psychosis{[lvl]} (2 skulls)
details: A pickup-hallucination spawn is checked after more than 20 seconds.

entries.name: Color Blindness{[lvl]} (1 skull)
details: Grayscale blend strength: 66%.
This changes rendered color, without a fixed gameplay-stat penalty.

entries.name: Color Blindness{[lvl]} (2 skulls)
details: Grayscale blend strength: 100%.
This changes rendered color, without a fixed gameplay-stat penalty.

entries.name: Peg Leg{[lvl]} (3 skulls)
details: The amputation's own speed penalty varies from 0% to 60% in a 0.6-second cycle.
With a separate Limp affliction, its curve changes this to 0-48%; the separate Limp penalty also applies.

entries.name: Obsidian Harpoon
details: Held-spear base melee damage: 4.
Spear projectile base impact damage: 10.
Final damage varies with charge and other combat modifiers.

entries.name: Tunnel Vision{[lvl]} (1 skull)
details: The peripheral-vision effect uses a texture mask rather than a fixed degree cutoff.
The additional narrowed mask is blended at 0% strength.
Blend strength is not a percentage of screen area lost.

entries.name: Tunnel Vision{[lvl]} (2 skulls)
details: The peripheral-vision effect uses a texture mask rather than a fixed degree cutoff.
The additional narrowed mask is blended at 50% strength.
Blend strength is not a percentage of screen area lost.

entries.name: Tunnel Vision{[lvl]} (3 skulls)
details: The peripheral-vision effect uses a texture mask rather than a fixed degree cutoff.
The additional narrowed mask is blended at 100% strength.
Blend strength is not a percentage of screen area lost.

entries.name: Myopic{[lvl]} (1 skull)
details: Pickup-visibility shader radius: 10 world units around you.
The clipping shader controls the edge; this does not change pickup reach.

entries.name: Myopic{[lvl]} (2 skulls)
details: Pickup-visibility shader radius: 5 world units around you.
The clipping shader controls the edge; this does not change pickup reach.

entries.name: A Gift for the Laborers
details: Enables extra pot and barrel spawn points designated by the arena layout.
The additional count depends on the arena; there is no fixed percentage or universal number.

entries.name: A Gift for the Quartermaster
details: Enables extra weapon spawn points designated by the arena layout.
The additional count depends on the arena; there is no fixed percentage or universal number.

The extra recovery also runs during the normal recovery delay.
